newsitem.title: USA: Flamel files IND for Asacard product.
newsitem.headline: Flamel files IND for Asacard product.

text.p: Flamel Technologies SA of Lyon, France said on Monday it filed an Investigational New Drug application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its Asacard cardiovascular aspirin product.
Asacard is a controlled-release formulation for aspirin intended to maintain its efficacy while avoiding its gastric side effects.
Flamel also said it is preparing to file an IND application for Viropump, its controlled-release formulation for acicylovir to treat chronic genital herpes.
In January, the company began a Phase III study of Viropump in France for treating acute genital herpes.

Flamel also said its Medusa technology for delivering proteins and peptides is making progress in pre-clinical studies. The company seeks to develop it as a longer-acting formulation of insulin for treating diabetes.
